args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Follow-up: confirm recovery after the rollback and find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, the service reports healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%. No change-manager approval was needed, since that's only required for versions that have never been healthy in production.
- **Incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** It describes the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the follow-up work. The incident text asks to confirm recovery, but I opened it at the same time as the health check, so it doesn't say that recovery is already confirmed. The other follow-up is to find the root cause before v2.3.1 is redeployed.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
